title: Product Feature Callout Video Template | AIVideosUGC
description: Create a product feature callout video from one photo. Show one useful detail in a short scene, then add the verified feature name or label in your editor.
h1: Product Feature Callout Videos for One Clear Detail
lead: Product feature callout video ads keep one useful detail in view. Upload a product photo, describe the action, and get a focused clip for a product page, TikTok, or Reels; add the verified feature name yourself.
intro: A feature callout works when shoppers can see one thing happen. The sample presses a white cleanser pump, spreads the foam, and keeps the action close enough to understand without a presenter.

Use this format for a pump, hinge, texture, clasp, or other visible feature. AIVideosUGC can show the action, but it cannot verify ingredients, measurements, or small package text; add those facts in your editor after you check them.
tip: Describe one visible feature and one action, then leave any ingredient, size, or performance statement for text you add yourself.

steps.d: Upload a photo where the pump, texture, clasp, or control you want to show is easy to see.
Write a short scene such as a hand pressing the pump and spreading the foam in clean bathroom light.
Download the clip and add your product name, feature wording, and any required disclosure yourself.

ideas.d: Show a cream, gel, or drink pouring into a glass without making an unsupported claim.
Use a close movement for a zipper, lid, hinge, button, or charging port.
Show the feature once in the package and once in a real setting.

faq.q: Will the video write my feature label correctly?
faq.a: No. The generated scene may not render small words accurately. Add the checked feature name, ingredients, measurements, and disclosures after downloading.

faq.q: Can I show more than one feature?
faq.a: You can make separate runs for separate features. Keeping one detail per clip makes the action easier to understand.

faq.q: Does the clip include a spoken narration or music?
faq.a: AIVideosUGC does not add spoken narration, music, or captions. Add your spoken or written explanation in your editor after download.

faq.q: How should I describe a product feature?
faq.a: Name one visible feature and one action, such as “presses the locking tab.”

overview.h2: Make one feature easy to notice
overview.d: A callout clip should have one subject and one visible action: a pump pressed, a clasp closed, a hinge opened, or a texture spread. Start with the detail a shopper needs to inspect, then keep the scene close enough to follow.

overview.h2: Let the overlay carry verified wording
overview.d: The generated motion can show what happens, but verify ingredients, measurements, compatibility, and performance statements before adding them as text.

input_guide.h2: Photograph the feature before you describe it

items.d: Keep the pump head, clasp, zipper, button, hinge, or port large enough to remain visible through the action.
Include enough of the full product that the viewer can tell where the feature belongs.
A side view suits a hinge or zipper; a top view can suit a pump or lid; choose the angle that shows movement.
Describe opens, closes, dispenses, pours, or connects rather than listing several benefits in one request.
The short scene puts one physical detail at the center so shoppers can see how it moves.
Use 9:16 for social, 1:1 for a feed, 16:9 for a product page, or 4:3 and 3:4 for another crop.
Six, ten, fifteen, and thirty seconds use 24, 40, 60, and 120 credits; the cost is visible before creation.
A hand presses a cleanser pump once, foam gathers on fingertips, and the bottle remains upright beside the sink.
A leather wallet opens on a desk, the clasp closes with one motion, and the camera returns to the full shape.
A hand lifts the lid, steam leaves the spout, and the kettle settles back on its base.
A cable connects to a small device on a desk, with the port and plug visible in one close movement.
Add the exact feature title and model wording from your product information.
Type capacity, dimensions, ingredients, or compatibility only after checking the source listing.
Add music, a short sound effect, or spoken narration in the editor that will publish the clip.

good: Pumps, caps, hinges, clasps, and ports
One product detail on a product page
Short social demonstrations without a presenter
not_ideal: Performance or medical claims that need testing
Features hidden inside software or unreadable small print

examples.lead: One feature at a time, shown in close-up, with the whole product before and after.

items.title: Wallet snap clasp opened in close-up
Portable blender lid locked with one press
Laptop stand raised to a new height
